new_result.statement: If (S,R) has arbitrary joint density <=M, V is independent with density <=N, ab!=0, and G,H,K are arbitrary measurable, then Q=a(S+G(R))^2+2bRV+H(R)+K(V) satisfies integral |t|^(-1/2)|phi_Q(t)|^2 dt <=3 sqrt(6 pi)(MN)^(1/3)|a|^(-1/6)|b|^(-1/3). Equivalently E|Q-Q'|^(-1/2)<=3 sqrt(3)(MN)^(1/3)|a|^(-1/6)|b|^(-1/3), with Q' an independent copy of the whole scalar output.
scope_notes: No marginal density cap for R is required.
Arbitrary same-bank shear G(R) and baggage H(R) are retained.
Arbitrary scalar phase K(V), including a nonzero physical square pivot dV^2, is retained exactly.
This is a negative-half collision/time estimate, not by itself a one-copy L-infinity density theorem.
